agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has controller noise=0.209 and kp=25.9, vcmd=13.43. At step 1 controller_force=144.736 exceeds fmax=111.335. With identical scenario but noise=0, force is clamped to exactly fmax (111.335) and no violation. Likely cause: noise is added to sensor/velocity-error after or instead of inside the clamp, so noisy command bypasses fmax limiting.
